_about: Generators, tools and ready-made sources, with the status the checks enforce. Only status 'approved' may appear in a recipe. Evidence, links and dates for every entry are in THIRD_PARTY_LICENCES.md. Changing a status is a licence ruling: the lead recommends, the owner decides.

statuses.conditional: Usable only once the listed conditions are met and recorded in a decision. Not accepted by the checks until promoted to approved.
statuses.rejected: Licence forbids what this project needs. Do not use.
statuses.unverified: Nobody has read the primary source yet. Do not use.
